name: dsh-think-expand

scripts.check:syntax: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm test && npm run check:package
scripts.check:release: npm run check:syntax && npm test && node scripts/check-package.mjs --strict
scripts.release:prepare: npm run check:syntax && npm test && node scripts/check-package.mjs --release

description: Keeps the Think rows you open by hand open when DSH or dsh-claude-style folds them, with no setup, plus a per-session switch that opens or closes every Think row of one session.
author: BrianHIO-x
